svg.title: Three-Sensor Array
svg.desc: This configuration uses three evenly spaced sensor locations to detect obstacles across the robot’s front edge.
svg.text: positions 1, 3, and 5 installed across the front sensor board
This configuration uses three evenly spaced sensor locations
to detect obstacles across the robot’s front edge.
Use the highlighted sensor positions shown in the photo below.
• Sensors 1, 3, and 5 are populated across the board.
• This gives the robot right, front, and left coverage.
• Use this arrangement when you want the standard 3-sensor layout.
Using positions 1, 3, and 5 creates a balanced front-facing sensor layout with left, center, and right coverage.
